source: statute expect examples/expect/newsletter_test.md --url http://localhost:4173/ --fix --app demo-store (real Kane CLI 0.10.8 runs and a real Claude Code fix, on a local copy of the demo shop)

timeline.why: 2 expectations broken: text "jane.doe@example.com" never leaves this site; what was typed in "Sign up for the newsletter" never leaves this site.

results.rule: what was typed in "Sign up for the newsletter" never leaves this site
results.detail: what was typed in "Sign up for the newsletter" reached 1 other host: www.google-analytics.com (URL-encoded)

timeline.summary:
What was wrong: `tags.js` loaded Google Analytics and the Meta pixel on every page as soon as it loaded, before the visitor chose anything and even after "Reject all". The banner only saved the choice and hid itself.

What I changed: `public/tags.js` now reads the consent cookie on every page and adds the tags only when it says "accepted". `public/consent.js` loads them right away when someone clicks "Accept all", so analytics still works after Accept. Both files pass `node --check`; I haven't run it in a browser, so Kane's re-check will confirm it.
